description: This file defines constants and a function related to Extended Key Usage (EKU) OIDs used in X.509 certificates, including specific OIDs for serverAuth, clientAuth, codeSigning, emailProtection, timestamping, and OCSP signing, as well as a parser function for EKU extensions.

methods.name: ParseEKUExtension
methods.description: Parses the extension value of an Extended Key Usage extension in an X.509 certificate and populates a vector with DER-encoded OID values.
